gitCommit.subject: Public site: one link system, hamburger phone menu, EN/FR/AR language codes
gitCommit.body:
Public site: one link system, hamburger phone menu, EN/FR/AR language codes

The owner's consistency brief, on site-redesign only (production unchanged).

Links, by context: an audit of all 57 built pages (public, legal, /in-app/,
EN/FR/AR) found five families still rendering as browser-default anchors.
- Running text: brand colour, a set 1 px underline (--link-line) that
  thickens on hover and focus; long addresses wrap.
- Tables of contents: rows of at least 44 px with the section number in a
  decorative marker; long titles wrap beside it; RTL puts it on the right.
  The ol and the real #anchors are kept; scroll-padding lands each heading
  below the sticky header (instant jump, nothing to reduce).
- Related pages (legal footers, the legal notice, /in-app/ footer): compact
  pills; the current page marked aria-current and drawn quiet.
- Operator telephones: compact contact rows like the contact cards, same
  values and tel: links, named "Call +222 ...".
- A link standing alone under a section (Support): a text action with arrow.
- Footer columns: a larger hit area and an offset underline.

Phone menu: a 44 px icon button (three lines / cross), no visible word. The
prerendered page keeps a native <details> so the menu still opens without a
script; once hydrated it is a <button> with aria-expanded, aria-controls and
a localized name (Open menu / Close menu). The panel is hidden while closed;
Escape and choosing a destination close it and return focus to the button;
an outside press or Tab past the last link closes it. Not a modal, so no
focus trap; a short screen scrolls the panel.

Languages: EN, FR, AR wherever a language is chosen (header, phone menu,
/in-app/ header, protected areas), each named in full in its own lang for
assistive technology; switching, persistence, current mark, lang/dir and
theme unchanged. No flags.

Tests: test/site-navigation.test.tsx (16) and four browser tests per
language in e2e/public-site.spec.ts (menu at 320/375 by keyboard; language
from the menu keeps page and dark mode across reload; no default-styled link
on any public or /in-app/ page; contents rows land below the header at 375
and 1280). The full-site keyboard test now drives the menu button.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01WqJ1WH6TJWfctbXGjyqFZt
